entry: **Browse a local site (`S15.toolset-create`, `S15.navigate-and-read`, `S15.interact`, `S15.tabs`, `S15.storage`, `S15.observation`, `S15.recording-start-stop`, `S15.prompt-guidance`, `S15.action-routing`, `S15.cleanup`).** A scripted agent with `Tool(name="browser_tool_set")` and a real headless Chromium works through a two-page site. It navigates, reads state with a screenshot, reads content with links and from character 2,000, and scrolls. It types a name and clicks Greet, follows a link and goes back, opens a second tab, reads storage, restores a saved `storage_state`, clicks a missing element, and stops a recording that never started. Then it switches to the first tab and closes the second. Element indexes and tab ids are known only once a page loads, so each turn swaps in the next scripted model with `conversation.switch_llm`. The agent follows the flow the browser guidance prescribes: `browser_get_state` after an interaction, then `browser_get_content`. | **Closing a tab that is not focused (`S15.tabs`).** A `BrowserToolExecutor` opens `page2.html` in a new tab, switches back to the first tab, closes the new one and lists the tabs at once, five times.
